bio: A spot in the conservatory is an absolute must when you come to this restaurant in a converted courthouse – the view of the water and the passing boats is magnificent! The restaurant is open throughout the day, so you can come for lunch, high tea or dinner. The chef skilfully navigates his way between classic and modern culinary traditions. For instance, he won't do too much to a steak tartare, but then he will conjure up a vegetarian dish based on roasted fennel and an apple jus. Be sure to check out the Asian-inspired appetisers....
